task: pMapIterable keeps pulling from its source after the source has reported done. With a source that blocks or throws when next() is called after exhaustion (as a queue does), this leaves a pending call behind or surfaces errors that a plain for-await loop would never trigger. Once the source reports done, no further next() calls should be made.
setup: npm install --no-save --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --no-package-lock ava@^5.2.0 chalk@^5.3.0 delay@^6.0.0 in-range@^3.0.0 random-int@^3.0.0 time-span@^5.1.0
